tagline: Electrolytes, with the declared ingredients kept in view.
description: We screen declared formulas against the applicable ingredient rules. Electrolyte amounts, serving sizes and product preferences remain separate facts to compare.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.screening_note: Published references have a readable, complete ingredient declaration checked against the applicable ingredient restrictions in charter 0.15.0. This first filter does not certify nutritional quality, efficacy or laboratory testing.
copy.audience_note: This selection is for adults and does not determine individual medical suitability.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your hydration?
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 379 hydration products reaching Kuwait and published none. Publication requires a completed ingredient check and an available Kuwait offer. Unresolved declarations and unavailable offers remain in the audit.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Editorial choices among ingredient-admitted references, recorded in the database.

types.name: Electrolytes
types.purpose: Sodium, potassium and magnesium replacement — which in Kuwait is not optional.
types.shelf_note: Kuwait summers make this the most consequential shelf on the site. We weight sodium content harder here than we would in a temperate market.

types.name: Intra-Workout Carbohydrate
types.purpose: Fast fuel for sessions past the ninety-minute mark.
